continuousnet.description: Continuing full-time after my end-of-studies internship, I drive feature development across two tracks. On mobile, I design and ship Flutter features serving travellers, guides, drivers, and agency staff — real-time chat, a loyalty rewards system, flight search, and activity booking — while owning UI design and performance optimization end-to-end. On the NestJS backend, I own the hotel room booking engine and maintain the integrations layer: the architecture that normalises third-party flight, hotel, and activity provider APIs into a unified internal contract, keeping the rest of the platform decoupled from external API churn.
highlights: Designed and shipped Flutter features across 4 user roles — real-time chat, loyalty rewards, flights, and activity booking with performance-first UI
Owned the NestJS hotel room booking engine from business logic through to API contract
Built and maintained the integrations layer that normalises third-party provider APIs into a unified internal interface, decoupling the platform from external API changes

continuousnet-intern.description: Designed and built the complete messaging ecosystem powering the ZenifyTrip platform across three travel agencies. Developed the full backend — a multi-tenant NestJS server, a Matrix Synapse homeserver with PostgreSQL for E2E-encrypted real-time communication, and FastAPI AI microservices for translation, summarization, and intelligent travel assistance. Created a reusable Flutter messaging SDK deployed across 3 mobile apps featuring offline support, audio/video calls, geolocation, and AI capabilities. The entire system was containerized and automated with GitLab CI/CD, Docker Compose, Portainer, and monitored with Grafana/Prometheus.
highlights: Architected and deployed a multi-tenant NestJS + Matrix Synapse messaging backend with E2E encryption across 3 agencies
Built FastAPI AI microservices for real-time translation, summarization, and intelligent travel assistance
Created a reusable Flutter messaging SDK spanning 3 mobile apps with audio/video calls, geolocation, and offline support
Containerized and automated the full system with GitLab CI/CD, Docker Compose, Portainer, Grafana, and Prometheus

Integrated secure online payment and real-time Firebase sync
Applied Clean Architecture with Riverpod across a role-based e-commerce app

esprit.description: Designed and delivered a full-stack internship management platform for ESPRIT — one of Tunisia's largest engineering schools. Built a reactive Angular SPA consuming a Spring Boot REST API secured with JWT, covering the entire student lifecycle from application to final evaluation. Implemented role-based dashboards for students, supervisors, and administrators, complete with document management, automated email notifications, and real-time progress tracking across 2 000+ students.
highlights: Built a reactive Angular 16 SPA with role-based routing for students, supervisors, and administrators
Designed a Spring Boot REST API with Spring Security + JWT covering auth, evaluation workflows, and document management
Implemented automated email notifications and real-time progress dashboards serving 2 000+ students
Wrote unit and integration tests with Jasmine/Karma on the frontend and JUnit on the backend

mbm-lab.description: Designed and built a production-grade HR & recruitment platform for MBM LAB using Symfony 6 and a Twig/Bootstrap frontend. Delivered a complete applicant tracking system covering job offer publication, multi-stage candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, and role-based access control for HR managers and department heads. Secured the platform with Symfony Security, implemented file handling for CV uploads with virus scanning, and optimised query performance with Doctrine eager loading — cutting average page load by 40%.
highlights: Architected a Symfony 6 MVC application with Doctrine ORM covering the full recruitment lifecycle — from job posting to hire
Implemented Symfony Security with role-based access control for HR managers, department heads, and candidates
Built CV upload and document management with server-side validation and optimised Doctrine queries — reducing page load by 40%
Wrote PHPUnit test suites for service and controller layers, achieving 80%+ coverage on core business logic

motivation.label: What Drives Me
motivation.title: Motivation & Values
motivation.subtitle: The passion and principles that guide my engineering journey.
motivation.quote: Progress happens step by step. I believe in improving consistently, learning constantly, and building things that make a real difference.
paragraphs: My passion for software started with a simple curiosity: how something written on a screen could come to life and impact people. As I learned and grew, I explored mobile development, backend engineering, cloud tools, and UX design, and with every step I discovered new ways technology can make life easier, more connected, or simply more enjoyable.

What shaped me the most wasn't a single project, but the continuous journey of improvement — the late nights spent learning a new concept, the challenges that forced me to rethink my approach, the small wins that slowly built confidence, and the satisfaction of turning ideas into something real and useful.

Today, what drives me is the desire to build software that feels natural, dependable, and thoughtful. I love creating systems that people enjoy using, codebases that teams enjoy maintaining, and experiences that blend functionality and emotion. For me, being a developer is not just about writing code — it's about growing, adapting, understanding humans, and building technology that genuinely matters.

motivations.title: Building Meaningful Digital Experiences
motivations.description: What motivates me most is creating products that genuinely help people. Whether it's improving communication for thousands of travelers or optimizing an internal tool used every day by companies, I thrive when my work has a real and measurable impact.

motivations.title: Turning Ideas Into Scalable Systems
motivations.description: I love transforming abstract ideas into fully functional, scalable solutions. From mobile apps to backend architectures, I enjoy designing systems that are clean, efficient, and engineered for long-term growth.

motivations.title: Solving Real-World Problems Through Technology
motivations.description: Technology is a universal language. I'm driven by the possibility of building software that makes everyday life easier — smarter communication, faster workflows, richer user experiences, and more connected communities.

motivations.title: Empowering Teams & Clients
motivations.description: I value collaboration and knowledge-sharing. Whether it's designing UI for a client, building an SDK for multiple applications, or helping teammates overcome challenges, I enjoy contributing to environments where everyone grows together.

values.title: User-Centered Mindset
values.description: Every feature I build starts with one question: does this improve the user's experience? Great products are born from empathy, clarity, and a deep understanding of how people interact with software.

values.title: Continuous Improvement
values.description: I am committed to learning every day — new frameworks, new architectures, new tools, new design principles. Technology evolves quickly, and I love growing with it.

values.title: Security & Reliability First
values.description: From secure authentication to encrypted messaging, I prioritize building systems that protect users and ensure high reliability. Quality isn't an option — it's a responsibility.

values.title: Knowledge Sharing
values.description: I believe in giving back: documenting solutions, mentoring, and helping teams adopt better practices. Sharing knowledge creates stronger teams and better products.
